title: BLK outreach research artifact
description: One artifact per firm. Every substantive field carries a firm-namespace URL, because a claim without a URL never reaches an email (rule 1). Drafting reads this file and nothing else (rule 6). This file holds the FIRM namespace only. How a contact was discovered lives in contact_provenance on the contact record, is marked internal_only, and never appears here.

firm_claim_url.description: A direct URL on a page the firm published. Search result pages and LinkedIn-scoped strings are rejected here: a search URL records what was typed into a box rather than what a firm said, and LinkedIn provenance belongs in contact_provenance (rules 1 and 3).

allOf.$comment: Rejects linkedin.com hosts and encoded site:linkedin.com search scopes alike.

value.description: The extracted claim, in the firm's own words.

source_url.description: The firm page this text was read off. Firm namespace, so the same direct-URL rules apply. Required, always.

quote.description: Surrounding text supporting the value, for 30-second review.

alignment_hooks.description: At most 3. Each is one sentence with its own firm_claim_source. These are the ONLY inputs drafting is allowed to see.

firm_claim_source.description: The URL that backs this hook. Named for the namespace it belongs to, so it can never be confused with contact discovery provenance.

basis.description: Which artifact field this hook was drawn from.

firm_claim_sources.description: Every distinct URL backing a firm claim in this artifact, in hook order. The evidence block maps each claim in a draft to one of these. A URL that is not in this list cannot be cited.

gaps.description: What could not be found. Read by the manual queue.
